text:
tara: Heads up, SCIM provisioning is failing for multiple customers after yesterday's RBAC change and KMS key rotation. Seeing `KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDenied` in prod logs.
cheng: investigating, grabbing logs — which key id?
devsec-bot: Alert: high error rate on /scim/provision (500) — automated throttle triggered.
tara: Key (redacted): arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. SCIM service `scim-provisioner-prod` started returning 500s. Sample log:```
2026-03-21T15:02:12Z ERROR scim-provisioner - KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDenied
```
ops-oncall: Can you repro with aws cli? `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload.bin --key-id alias/redwood-scim`
cheng: tried CLI with svc-scim-role creds — also AccessDenied. Looks like `kms:Decrypt` was dropped for that role. @mike did you touch svc-scim-role in yesterday's RBAC sweep?
mike: I removed some broad role bindings and hardened policies. I did modify svc-scim-role but only added condition on sourceVpc. I'll check.
irene: Also check CloudTrail for `KMS:Decrypt` failures and the key policy itself — sometimes IAM permissions are fine but key policy denies. We recently moved to an IAM principal condition for services.
tara: Short-term mitigation: either flip SCIM to use the legacy key or grant `kms:Decrypt` back to svc-scim-role. Need customer-facing rollback if queue keeps growing.
ops-oncall: I can apply a temporary key policy patch: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id <id> --policy file://temp-policy.json` — need owner approval before changing key policy.
mike: OK I'm applying a rollback patch to restore previous policy for svc-scim-role now (will post commit).
cheng: After the policy patch, local CLI decrypt succeeds and staging repro passes. SCIM queue in prod is draining.
tara: Great. Follow-ups: add CI coverage that validates KMS key policy for `svc-scim-role`, add an alert for spikes in KMS:Decrypt Denied, and run a postmortem on the RBAC sweep. I'll create the incident ticket and tag affected customers for CS.
ops-oncall: temporary fix applied and monitoring shows error rate back to normal — :thumbsup:
mike: will open PR to add an explicit test and update the RBAC runbook to include key-policy checks.
irene: also recommend adding an audit log export to long-term storage for easier triage next time.
tara: Thanks team, keeping this thread open until postmortem ready.
